evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: Creates the core resource (game) and no complementary capability required by other stories is missing.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Invitation mechanism complements game creation; no missing complementary story is required.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item
evaluations.rationale: Starting a round operates on items and the backlog contains item creation/edit/delete stories.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes adding, editing and deleting items; no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting an item is supported by item creation and listing stories; complementary capabilities exist.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Provides the creation capability for items referenced elsewhere (no missing complementary story).

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list
evaluations.rationale: Edit is paired with add/delete stories (PP-006, PP-008); complementary creation exists.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list
evaluations.rationale: Delete is supported alongside add/edit (no missing create capability).

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Requires estimate visibility which other stories (showing estimates, exporting transcripts) cover; no complementary capability absent.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting an aggregate is consistent with estimate collection stories; no missing complementary story.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Requires detection of estimates and unanimous condition; estimate collection stories exist, so no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Moderator-entered agreed estimate complements estimate collection and storage; backlog includes transcript/export features to persist results.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation relies on stored session items/estimates; backlog contains transcript/history stories to support this.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Import complements item creation and no required complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste is an alternate import path and does not expose a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Backlog contains game creation and transcript storage/export, so browsing previous games is supported by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Transcript viewing is supported by game creation and estimate storage/export stories; no complementary capability is absent.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Export functionality complements transcript storage; the backlog includes transcript and game storage stories.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: CSV export complements transcript storage; no missing complementary capability identified.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Delete complements game creation (PP-001) and export/browse stories; complementary create exists.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is present to support login and user-specific features; no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login complements account creation; complementary capability (account creation) exists.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Editing account details complements account creation and login; required create capability exists.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion complements account creation and there is no missing complementary story.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display is a presentation requirement and does not expose a missing complementary capability in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder complements account and login stories; required capabilities (email field in account) exist.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with ... sequences
evaluations.rationale: Card-set selection is self-contained and does not reveal any missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Invitation limit complements invitation mechanism (PP-002); no missing capability is visible.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Joining complements invitation and game creation; complementary capabilities exist.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Displaying the current item is supported by item creation/select stories; no missing complementary story.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes item list management and import; no complementary capability absent.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Requires showing per-estimator activity; joining and identity stories exist so complementary capabilities are present.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: This follows from estimate collection and reveal stories; backlog contains necessary estimate storage/visibility items.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card
evaluations.rationale: Changing estimates before reveal builds on estimate collection; no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Prior estimates require history; backlog includes transcripts and browsing previous games to provide this capability.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Identity and estimate visibility stories exist (join, account, transcripts); complementary capabilities are present.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Shared timer is a presentation/coordination feature and does not expose a missing complementary capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Auto-reset complements the shared timer story; no supporting capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: History and transcript stories exist to support scrolling back; no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering is a UI requirement and does not require any other missing story to be complete.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: This is covered by estimate collection/change stories; no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed
evaluations.rationale: The story requires showing a thumbnail photo but the backlog contains no complementary story for supplying or uploading avatar photos (e.g., upload/select avatar), which is necessary to realize this feature.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: This is a non-functional quality target and does not reveal any missing complementary capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Documentation requirement stands alone and does not expose missing functional capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Performance task is compatible with storage/features already described; no missing complementary story is evident.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Browser support is an implementation constraint and does not indicate missing functional stories.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility non-functional requirement, not exposing missing complementary capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance requirement that does not imply a missing functional story in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Internationalization requirement is standalone and does not reveal missing complementary capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL design is a presentation/UX requirement and does not expose missing functional stories.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error page design is non-functional and does not indicate missing complementary functionality.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: The backlog contains multiple stories that record or display identifiable user information (account creation, join-by-name, transcripts, per-estimator visibility) but lacks a complementary story specifying how to anonymize or store results non-identifiably (e.g., anonymization/pseudonymization/export options).

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics/reporting is a standalone feature and the backlog contains related storage/export stories to enable metrics; no complementary capability is missing.
